scope: Pinned Forge 65.1.2, publisher Oculus 0.3.0-beta.1 and Complementary Reimagined 5.7.1 with frozen private gbuffer bridge f0eb. All 11 hash-checked current-run contact sheets were manually inspected.
observations: Ghost and Wraith remain readable in day, night, rain, bright and dark backgrounds, and indoors; Wraith face and separated arms remain visible without washing out daylight shading.
Both native shader toggle sequences show OFF and ON states and coherent restored indoor scenes.
Movement displacement, red damage flashes, invisibility, spectator variants, and complete outlines are visible for both entities.
Block and lantern controls, worn armor and glint, item previews, projectiles, and the populated Spectral Infuser GUI render coherently.
limitations: Visual review covers this exact Complementary active run with the private bridge; the original community port and other stacks remain unresolved.
